description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Appointed members to the Wages Board of the Paddy Hulling Trade
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists the appointment of named individuals (e.g., Mr. W. N. S. Wickramasinghe, Mrs. Yashorawi Maheshika Bakmeewawa) to a Wages Board. It provides only their names and the board they are appointed to, with no detailed description of their specific responsibilities, duties, or portfolio areas. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2), which covers government personnel changes without detailed portfolio information.
